origin.description: Rewrite a gsub replacement string into ICU replacement syntax.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Character vector of gsub-style replacement strings.

origin.details: A dollar sign becomes a backslash and a dollar sign. A doubled backslash stays a doubled backslash. \\1 through \\9 become $1 through $9, and a following digit is escaped so \\12 becomes $1\\2. Any other backslash escape keeps the following character. A trailing backslash is dropped. \\0 becomes 0. A missing string stays NA.

translation.description: Rewrite a gsub replacement string into ICU replacement syntax.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

translation.details: A dollar sign becomes a backslash and a dollar sign. A doubled backslash stays a doubled backslash. \\1 through \\9 become $1 through $9, and a following digit is escaped so \\12 becomes $1\\2. Any other backslash escape keeps the following character. A trailing backslash is dropped. \\0 becomes 0. A missing string stays NA.
translation.value: A list of strings. A missing result is NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.regex import stri_replace_rstr
result = stri_replace_rstr("\\1")
print(f'stri_replace_rstr("\\\\1") returns {result[0]}.')
